date.description: Date on which the event will occur/has occurred.

detailed.description: Detailed event should be hidden in a space constrained UI.

bestMember.description: Best member on the competition's leaderboard.

memberCount.description: Number of member on the competition's leaderboard.

totalPoints.description: Total number of points earned by the institution's members on the competition.

displayName.description: The display name of the currency.

symbol.description: The symbol of the currency. Does not include the `$` prefix.

dollarExchangeRate.description: The current exchange rate in USD.

blockchain.description: Which address should be used to receive the currency. `FIAT` is not supported.

websiteUrl.description: Website URL giving more documentation about the currency.

transactionUrlFormat.description: Explorer URL format of a transaction. Use `{transactionHash}` as a variable for the `Payout.transactionHash`.

addressUrlFormat.description: Explorer URL format of an address. Use `{address}` as a variable for the `PayoutRecipient.address`.

rank.description: Rank of the user for the requested leaderboard.

points.description: Points of the user for the requested leaderboard.

bestRank.description: Best rank (from previous leaderboards) of the user for the requested leaderboard.

participationCount.description: Number of participated competitions for the requested leaderboard.

submissionCount.description: Number of submissions of the user for the requested leaderboard.

id.description: Span ID, unique within a run.

parentId.description: Parent span ID, null if high level.

endedAt.description: End time of the span, null if not ended yet.

attributes.description: Span attributes, null if no attributes.

error.description: Error message if the span ended with an error, null otherwise.

cruncherPubkey.description: The Cruncher Pubkey on the blockchain. Only available if `competition.type` is `REAL_TIME`.

hidden.description: Is the participant hidden from the leaderboard?

role.description: Role of the participant in the competition.

submitted.description: Has the participant submitted at least once?

rank.description: Rank of the user in the institution. Updated daily.

leader.description: Team leader, or `null` if leaders are disabled.

stakeGoal.description: Staking goal to reach in the season.

competition.description: Competition related to this runtime access request.

project.description: Project who the request made for.

submission.description: Submission who the request made for.

user.description: User who match the address. `null` if none is matching.

organizer.description: Target of the stake. Only included if `includeTarget=true`

statusMessage.description: Message explaining the status, often used to report the error message if `status` ~= `*_FAILED`.

builderLogsAvailable.description: Are logs from the builder available?

runnerLogsAvailable.description: Are logs from the runner available?

id.description: Fake ID, but still unique for a leaderboard.

projectId.description: The ID of the project this security credentials belong to.

certificatePublicKey.description: The public key of the certificate used for signing.

hotKey.description: The hot key used for signing the message.

cruncherWalletPublicKey.description: The cruncher's wallet owning the hot key.

signedAt.description: When was the message signed. `null` if not yet signed.

signature.description: The signature of the message. `null` if not yet signed.

onChainId.description: On chain address linked to this organizer. Only set if is a coordinator.

stake.description: Staking information. Only set if `onChainId` is also set.

requestedFor.description: Competition for which the library is requested.

weeklyStreak.description: Count of consecutive week where the current user participated.

totalRewards.description: Total amount of rewards the user ever received/will receive.

totalRuns.description: The total number of runs created, in any competitions.

lastParticipant.description: The last competition the participant registered to.

quota.description: Remaining quota, with the quota factor applied.

recommended.description: If this runtime option is recommended for the submission.

status.description: Usability status of this runtime option.

name.description: Slug-like name of the chart, is unique and can be used as key.

displayName.description: Title of the chart, displayed in the UI.

dataKey.description: Data key to find the fetched data.

projectIdProperty.description: If set, generate a series per project. The project ID must be matched from the current's user projects.

nativeConfiguration.description: Native (series-based or just a single series) frontend configuration for the chart.

order.description: Ordering order in the UI. Lowest is first.

targets.description: Sub-leaderboards when the leaderboard is published.

participants.description: List of participants when the ranking is still hidden.

recommendable.description: Can the recommended badge be possible?

accessRequestRequired.description: Does this runtime requires an approval to be used?

quotaConsumptionRate.description: How fast the quota is consumed for this runtime. `1` is normal speed, `<1` slower (more quota), `>1` faster (less quota).

unit.description: Unit to format the value. None if `null`.

signless.description: Ignore and hide the sign of the value.

weight.description: Weight of the value used for the weighted average.

minimum.description: Minimum value allowed before being considered out of range. `null` if there is no minimum.

maximum.description: Maximum value allowed before being considered out of range. `null` if there is no maximum.

score.description: Is it a score that is not considered in the weighted average?

multiplier.description: Multiplier used to convert the raw value (divide to get the original value).

cumulative.description: Are previous values are needed to compute the final score.

scorerFunction.description: Scoring function to use implemented in the crunch-cli.

reducerFunction.description: Reducer function to consume the value to get the score.

reducedDisplayName.description: Display name for the reducer function.

visualizationType.description: Type of visualization used to display the values.

visibleOnPerformanceGraph.description: Is the line visible on the performance graph.

globalRank.description: Rank of the institution in the global leaderboard. Updated daily.

details.description: Detailed quota usage for each crunches.

target.description: Target entity type. `SELF` is the current team.

votes.description: List of users who have already voted.

teamSize.description: Size of the team at the time of the referendum. Always updated during the referendum.

status.description: English status of the referendum. Includes errors.

certificatePemString.description: The authority certificate used for signing other credentials.

submissionNumber.description: The submission number. Must be specified if `submissionId` is not.

submissionId.description: The submission id. Must be specified if `submissionNumber` is not. Must be owned by the project.

name.description: Project name, must be a slug.

rank.description: Rank of the institution for the requested leaderboard.

totalPoints.description: Sum of all the user's points of the institution for the requested leaderboard.

userCount.description: Number of members of the institution for the requested leaderboard.

topUsers.description: Top 3 users of the institution for the requested leaderboard.

averagePointsPerUser.description: Average number of points of the institution's members for the requested leaderboard.

weight.description: Weight of the target in the global leaderboard.

weightedMeanUnit.description: Display name for the UI of the weighted mean column.

primary.description: Is the target displayed on the home page?

virtual.description: Is the target based on other targets.

rankOrder.description: Orders of the position on the leaderboard.

PitchStatus.description: Filter for pitches with a specific status(es).

address.description: Address where the payout has been sent to.

value.description: Amount that has been sent to the address.

rank.description: Rank of the recipient in the payout.

claimed.description: If `Payout.type` is `CHECKPOINT`, did the user claim their payout? Uses a 3-state boolean, where null corresponds to a payout that cannot be claimed.

claimedAt.description: If `Payout.type` is `CHECKPOINT`, when did the user claim their payout?

claimTransactionHash.description: If `Payout.type` is `CHECKPOINT`, in which transaction was the claim made?

name.description: Descriptive name of the oauth client.

codeValidityDuration.description: How long is the authorization code valid? (only used if `flow` is `AUTHORIZATION_CODE`)

jwtValidityDuration.description: How long is the generated JWT valid?

displayName.description: Human-friendly name to display on the dashboard. Null for the `rank` property.

change.description: Change based on previous leaderboard value.

end.description: End of competition. (specified if not continuous)

external.description: Is the competition external? If so, redirect to `url`.

url.description: URL where the competition takes place.

onChainId.description: On-Chain ID where the competition takes place. Only if `mode` is `REAL_TIME`.

bannerImageUrl.description: Image URL used for the overview.

discussionUrl.description: External discussion platform URL. (either discord or the forum)

codeUrl.description: External GitHub URL where the code is located.

prizePoolText.description: Prize pool in a text form.

prizePoolShortText.description: Prize pool in a short text form.

projectNameFormat.description: Default project name format, use `{n}` for incremental.

onlyTeamLeader.description: Does only the team leader appear on the leaderboard?

projectCreationLimit.description: Maximum number of projects per user, if one, a default project is always created when the rules are accepted.

projectSelectionLimit.description: If multiple project can be created, how many should appear on the leaderboard?

allowPredictions.description: Are direct prediction file accepted for submission?

phalaKeyUrl.description: If the prediction should be encrypted, which URL to use to fetch the public key?

hideChanges.description: Are the dashboard change cards hidden?

hidePerformance.description: Is the dashboard performance graph hidden?

hideRunPerformance.description: Is the dashboard run performance graph hidden?

hideNotebookSetupCommand.description: Should the setup command for the notebook be hidden? Only useful for Real Time competitions.

hideTrainFrequency.description: Should the train frequency field be hidden?

hideForceFirstTrain.description: Should the train field be hidden?

web3.description: Are the web3 integrations enabled for the competitions? (e.g. team referendums)

session.description: Competition current session. No session if `null`.

prefix.description: String to show before the value.

suffix.description: String to show after the value.

scale.description: Number of digits to keep after the comma.

points.description: Number of points on the global leaderboard. Updated daily.

globalRank.description: Rank of the user in the global leaderboard. Updated daily.

property.description: Property name that must be read from the values object.

displayName.description: Column display name used in the table header.

tooltip.description: Tooltip to show when hovering on the table header column. Can be `null`.

nativeConfiguration.description: Native frontend configuration for the cell. If `null`, render as regular string.

nextChange.description: When should the next session state change happen. Unknown if `null`.

all.description: Include ALL runs, not only thoses who failed or don't have a score.

writeupUrl.description: Writeup URL, only included on Out-of-Sample leaderboards.

cpu.description: CPU usage in percentage, one per timestamp.

ram.description: RAM usage in bytes, one per timestamp.

disk.description: Disk usage in bytes, one per timestamp.

gpu.description: GPU usage in percentage, one per timestamp. `null` if not available.

vram.description: VRAM usage in bytes, one per timestamp. `null` if not available.

nativeConfiguration.description: Native frontend configuration for the chart.

externalUrlText.description: Used to change displayed link text for `externalUrl`.

userCount.description: Number of users on this leaderboard.

institutionCount.description: Number of institutions on this leaderboard.

published.description: Is the leaderboard published for everyone to see?

standard.description: If the package is part of the stdlib.

freeze.description: If the package's version need to be frozen at the time of submission.

performance.description: Performance of the institution in the competition.

SeasonStatus.description: Filter for seasons with a specific status(es).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the signature occurred. In seconds since the epoch.

rawMessage.description: The raw message before it is signed.
